details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:178-264,2841-2849,5722-5728,9433-9439,10801-10810 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: build_judge_semble_query is invoked through command substitution, so the piped context never reaches the Python stdin reader and the judge prefetch only sees the label.
  WHY: The same stdin-loss chain is reported at every judge callsite, so the PR/issue context is discarded before Semble query construction.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:26-137,328-341 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: build_rb_judge_semble_query has the same command-substitution stdin loss, so the review-blocked prefetch only sees the label.
  WHY: Reviewers describe the same heredoc/$(...) stdin consumption bug here, with the piped PR diff/comments never reaching Python.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:371-447 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The install step never writes SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true, so the later index-build gate still sees false and skips Semble initialization.
  WHY: Reviewers agree the workflow only records SEMBLE_BIN; without flipping SEMBLE_AVAILABLE the build step exits early even after a successful install.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128,223-229 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Replacing issue_meta_matches_issue with a non-empty file check lets stale ISSUE_META_FILE data from another issue seed the diagnose prompt.
  WHY: The old jq guard enforced .number == ISSUE_NUMBER, and reviewers who called this out rated it high; some also noted the change is outside files_touched.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-450 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-path Semble query assembly and semble_query_block call were deleted, removing repo-context enrichment from post-Codex failure diagnosis.
  WHY: This reverts the prompt to a thinner context set; reviewers split between medium and high severity, so the consensus uses high.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-86,134-139,392-397 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: _normalize_semble_max_chunks drops the clamp, so callers can feed invalid 0/negative/huge values straight into semble query --max-chunks.
  WHY: Reviewers split between medium and high severity, but all agree the parameter is now unbounded, so the consensus uses high.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:418-440 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Removing _log_semble_event and the SEMBLE_QUERY emission strips structured Semble telemetry from successful queries.
  WHY: The observable key=value event is gone and fallback logging is simplified, weakening operator visibility.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:178-264 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: build_judge_semble_query reads only a fixed 65536-byte blob from stdin with no streaming or timeout handling.
  WHY: Large or slow inputs can be truncated or block the helper; only qwen reported this issue.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:429-430 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The build step rewrites SEMBLE_BIN with the same value that install already wrote to $GITHUB_ENV.
  WHY: It has no runtime effect because the binary path was already exported earlier.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:106-126 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The script sources scripts/semble_helpers.sh early and assumes the helper definitions are present, so a missing upstream file can turn judge prefetch into a silent no-op.
  WHY: The warning path continues without a fallback when declare -F semble_query_block is absent, so judge context enrichment is lost.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:286-292 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The bootstrap step installs optional upstream scripts without verifying their existence or contents.
  WHY: Missing or malformed install_semble.sh/semble_helpers.sh in the upstream bundle can make Semble bootstrap fail silently.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:29-45,47-59,65-73 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The unresolved-placeholder guard only matches an exact single-line {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} token and misses malformed whitespace or multiline variants.
  WHY: Those variants can slip through rendering and leave prompts broken without tripping the guard.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:1-149 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The new test file exercises render_prompt.sh but does not assert the runtime pipe chain in orchestrate_poll_process.sh or review_rb_judge.sh.
  WHY: That leaves the stdin-loss bug untested, so the wiring can regress while the test still passes.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:183-238,2841-2849,5722-5728,9433-9439,10801-10810 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: stdin data is discarded at every Semble prefetch callsite, so the judge Semble context enrichment is dead code.
  WHY: The heredoc-fed Python helper reads stdin after the pipe has already been consumed, leaving only the label text instead of the PR/issue context.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:52-101,329-338 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: stdin data is discarded at the review-blocked Semble prefetch callsite, so the context enrichment is dead code.
  WHY: The same heredoc/command-substitution stdin-loss path leaves the Python helper with empty input.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:399-416 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_AVAILABLE is never set to true after Semble installs, so the build step can silently skip.
  WHY: The workflow seeds SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=false and never flips it before the build gate checks it.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128,344-376 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The issue metadata guard was weakened and the Semble diagnose query was removed from the post-Codex failure path.
  WHY: The old check prevented stale issue metadata from being used, and the removed Semble block previously enriched the diagnose prompt.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-86,134-139,392-397,418-423,425-440 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The clamp on semble_max_chunks and the structured Semble telemetry were removed.
  WHY: Raw values now flow directly to sembla query --max-chunks and the SEMBLE_QUERY/SEMBLE_FALLBACK structured stderr events are gone.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:437 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The build step rewrites SEMBLE_BIN with the same value already written by install.
  WHY: The second write does not change runtime behavior.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:244-262 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Stdin data is lost when build_judge_semble_prefetch() calls build_judge_semble_query() through command substitution.
  WHY: The piped context never reaches the Python helper, so only the label text is used.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:122-137 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The same stdin-loss bug affects build_rb_judge_semble_prefetch().
  WHY: Command substitution drops the piped context before the Python helper reads stdin.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:390-447 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflow never explicitly writes SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true after installing Semble.
  WHY: The build step checks SEMBLE_AVAILABLE and will skip index generation while it remains false.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128,223-229 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: issue_meta_matches_issue() was removed, so the diagnose path only checks for a non-empty metadata file.
  WHY: That allows stale metadata from the wrong issue to seed labels and body text.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-376 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Semble prefetch/query assembly was deleted from the diagnose path.
  WHY: The post-Codex failure diagnose prompt no longer gets Semble-enriched repository context.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:134-139,392 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: _normalize_semble_max_chunks() and SEMBLE_MAX_CHUNKS_CAP were removed, so the parameter is no longer bounded.
  WHY: Invalid 0, negative, or oversized values can now flow directly into semble query --max-chunks.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:392-440 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Successful Semble overflow queries no longer emit structured SEMBLE_QUERY events.
  WHY: The structured telemetry was removed and fallback logging was simplified, weakening observability.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:429-430 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The build step writes SEMBLE_BIN to $GITHUB_ENV again even though the install step already did.
  WHY: The second write is redundant and does not change runtime behavior.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~244-262 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The piped stdin data is lost when build_judge_semble_prefetch() calls build_judge_semble_query() via command substitution.
  WHY: The Python helper only sees the label text instead of the rich context from the outer pipe.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:~122-137 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The same stdin-loss bug affects build_rb_judge_semble_prefetch().
  WHY: The command-substitution subshell does not inherit the piped PR diff, issue body, or comments.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:~390-447 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The install step never explicitly writes SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true after successful Semble installation.
  WHY: The build step remains gated on false and skips Semble index generation unless an external script sets it.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128,223-229 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cached issue-metadata guard was removed, so the diagnose path now trusts any non-empty metadata file.
  WHY: The old guard checked that .number matched ISSUE_NUMBER and prevented stale metadata from another issue.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-450 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-path Semble enrichment block was removed.
  WHY: Post-Codex failure diagnosis no longer receives the repo-context enrichment it previously had.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:~134-139,~392-397 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: _normalize_semble_max_chunks() and the SEMBLE_MAX_CHUNKS_CAP clamp were removed.
  WHY: semble_max_chunks is now passed through without bounds checking, so invalid values can reach semble query --max-chunks.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:~415,~453-4
